title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the further deterioration of the political situation in Georgia
part_text: 11. Condemns the violence used by Georgia’s ruling regime against protesters since 28 November 2024; condemns the violence used by rioters against members of the Georgian police on duty during the riots; calls for the immediate and unconditional release of all politicalprisoners and those detained during the anti-government protests;
